create_quantization_recipe: create an AutoRoundModifier recipe to quantize model weights to 4-bit with W4A16 scheme and group size 128
run_autoround_quantization: run oneshot quantization on a transformer causal language model using AutoRound calibration dataset
build_calibration_dataset: build a calibration dataset from a tokenizer with configurable sequence length and number of samples
test_quantized_model_generation: test a quantized model by generating text completions and verifying output quality
save_compressed_quantized_model: save a quantized model and tokenizer to disk in compressed format
